verdict.rationale: Polar documents an official remote MCP server with production and sandbox endpoints (mcp.polar.sh) and OAuth-based authorization. It gives step-by-step client setup for Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Claude Desktop, and lets agents read data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
